title: Account-contextualizer-and-evidence-sparker-for-regulatory-asks
creator: Nora Patel
description: Build an account-aware intake component (Account Contextualizer) that enriches incoming enterprise security and compliance requests with contract, region, data-classification, and tier metadata, and an Evidence Sparker that produces a prioritized evidence bundle template and recommended SLA based on risk scoring. Goal: reduce manual triage time for security/compliance requests, increase percentage of auto-satisfied asks, and provide auditable rationale for decisions. The feature must respect data residency flags, HIPAA/SOC2 requirements, and avoid disclosing customer data to LLMs unless allowed.
acceptance_criteria: Incoming security/compliance requests are enriched with account metadata within 5s for 95% of requests
Evidence Sparker generates a prioritized evidence bundle (checklist + template artifacts) for SOC2, GDPR, HIPAA, and DPA-related asks in >75% of common questionnaire patterns
Triage UI surfaces suggested SLA lane (fast/standard/concierge) and confidence score; PM/SE can accept or override
Audit log records model prompts, risk score, chosen evidence templates, and user overrides for every automated decision
Integration tests validate that data residency flags block any offsite LLM invocation and fallback to internal templates
Metric: reduce average triage time from submission to assigned lane by 40% in pilot accounts
comments: 2026-03-01 - Nora Patel: Created ticket after synthesis workshop with Solutions Eng and CS. Problem: high variance in response time across enterprise accounts; many asks are repetitive but require manual evidence assembly.

2026-03-05 - Priya Shah (Security): Recommended strict opt-in for any LLM-assisted evidence generation when the account has 'sensitive_data' flag. Suggested fallback to curated internal templates stored in vault.

2026-03-07 - Engineering review (ENG-4210): Proposed architecture: small enrichment service (reads account metadata & contracts), local rules engine for initial risk mapping, LLM-assist only for template drafting (with scrubbed inputs). Identified need for per-account KMS integration.

2026-03-12 - Diego Ramirez: Created engineering tasks: ENG-5120 (enrichment service), ENG-5121 (rules engine), ENG-5122 (evidence-bundler service), ENG-5123 (triage UI). Added requirement for integration test harness for residency-safe behavior.
risks_and_tradeoffs: Automation vs correctness: aggressive automation increases speed but risks misclassifying high-stakes regulatory asks. Mitigation: conservative default mapping + confidence score + human-in-loop for high-risk accounts.
LLM exposure: using LLMs to draft evidence can leak sensitive context. Mitigation: require account opt-in and scrub inputs; default to internal templates for sensitive accounts.
Per-account schema variance: metadata normalization costs. Mitigation: build mapping adapters for top 10 customer schemas in MVP; generic fallback extractor for others.
Operational complexity: new enrichment service adds surface area. Mitigation: design with clear observability and throttling, include SLOs and canary rollout plan.
implementation_notes: Enrichment service reads from Accounts API and Contracts DB; must cache for 10m and include watch hooks for contract updates
Rules engine will be a simple ordered list with tunable weights for region, tier, active DPA, and last-90d incident history
Evidence-bundler composes a zip with checklist, prefilled templates, links to artifacts (logs, configs) and a short AI-drafted rationale (feature-flagged)
Audit log must store: request_id, account_id, enrichment snapshot, rule decisions, evidence template IDs, user overrides, timestamp
Expose metrics via Console's triage dashboard with drilldown by account and request type
